def f(N, prices, quantities):
    prices, quantities = list(prices), list(quantities)
    for i in range(4):
        q, p = divmod(quantities[i], N)
        quantities[i] = q if p == 0 else q+1
    res = 0
    for i in range(4):
        res += prices[i] * quantities[i]
    return res
